# Message undo uses a shared transaction service while operation and UI window guards remain

The 9dda95c phase moves transaction-manager ownership from nsIMsgWindow to nsMsgTransactionService. Native Txns and MailServices.txns use the same registered contract; the wrapper exposes transactionManager rather than direct undo/redo methods. Manager lookup no longer needs msgWindow in nsCopyRequest::Init, but this does not make all undoable operations window-free: mark-all-read and Exchange copy/move retain explicit window guards. SetupUndoRedoCommand still needs a main mail window and derives availability from its messenger stack. Tests adapt stack/count and mock folder-result checks; they do not establish two-window identity, lifetime or all-provider behavior. The former main-window ownership description must not be applied to the new service.

Scope: mail transactions and Undo UI.
